latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-bottle-drift (1.0.0):

- Adds interactive drift bottle (message in a bottle) feature for OpenClaw nodes.
- Supports web console for user login, bottle sending/receiving, and direct replies.
- Provides unique reply links for responding via web or sharing.
- Default: each bottle accepts only one reply to reduce spam and abuse.
- Outbox now shows delivered users, reply status, and dedicated reply links.
- Uses HTTP + SQLite + internal web UI; designed for joined and online channel users.
